ignoreValues.reason: NASA Horizon Design System names Inter as the heading face (--hds-font-family-heading, vendored CC0-1.0 in data/design/nasa-hds/tokens.json). Following nasa.gov is an explicit project directive, so the HDS face outranks the generic overused-font heuristic. Body text is Public Sans Web, which the rule does not flag.

The detector resolves colours without cascading @media (prefers-color-scheme), so it pairs light-scheme text with dark-scheme backgrounds on every prerendered page. Compensated by __tests__/staticShellContrast.test.js, which computes WCAG 2.1 ratios for both schemes from the generated shell CSS, and by the frontend/src scan where literal colour pairs stay checkable.

Matches the literal string '<img' inside inlined minified JavaScript in built pages, not a rendered image tag. Editorial imagery is verified against its committed manifest and licence ledger instead, and markup we author stays covered by the frontend/src scan.

$comment: Detector configuration for the vendored impeccable skill (see docs/design/impeccable.md). Every entry carries the reason it exists; a suppression is only allowed where a compensating check covers the same risk, and the compensating check is named in the reason.
